title: Bonita Coffe
description: For this project, I helped Widarto Impact visualize their newly designed packaging as part of a product rebranding. My role was to translate the new visual identity into engaging 3D product visuals that showcased the packaging, colors, and overall character of the refreshed brand.

process.heading: Bringing the New Identity Into 3D
process.body: I started by building the scene around the packaging, establishing the composition, camera perspective, and supporting elements before moving into materials and lighting.

process.heading: Setting Up the Scene
process.body: I started by building the scene around the actual packaging artwork. I used the original packaging design as a reference, folding it into the 3D model to match the proportions and dimensions of the real product as closely as possible.

process.heading: Final Result
process.body: The final visuals translate Widarto Impact's new packaging direction into a series of expressive 3D compositions, giving the refreshed identity a stronger presence across different campaign visuals.
